# Plotly.js gl3d bundle

- Version: 3.7.0
- Distribution: official `gl3d` minified partial bundle
- Source: <https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-gl3d-3.7.0.min.js>
- Upstream: <https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/tree/v3.7.0>
- SHA-256: `fa6ebaf365ea5ad46a9843ea98fb2635c998558b9d876578aa12f765f823cc3d`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The `gl3d` bundle is used because the Lie visualization requires both the
two-dimensional `scatter` trace and the three-dimensional `scatter3d` trace.
